latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Animated Video Maker AI — generate animated explainer and promo videos from text and images in the cloud.

- Upload images or video files (PNG, JPG, MP4, MOV up to 200MB) and describe your desired animation.
- Receives instructions and returns a ready-to-download 1080p MP4 in about 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in handling for script input, track editing, credit checks, and cloud-export with status updates.
- Simple session and token management; automatic prompt routing for exports, credits, uploads, and editing.
- Supports marketers, educators, and social media creators—no software install needed.
